asked_by: owner, 2026-09-04: an outcome-grounded health profile driver
source: player_transactions, which carries 27,255 IL events on 4,887 players with placements AND activations so cumulative days are computable. il_history is NOT usable as history: 1,415 of its 1,662 placements are 2026 and it was first populated 2026-06-06.
coverage_constraint: the IL archive starts in 2019, so pre-decision coverage is 0 percent for debut years 2016-2018, about 19 percent for 2019 and 39 to 79 percent for 2020-2024. A feature built on the full pool would encode DEBUT ERA rather than health, so every gated arm here runs on the observable cohort only.
